stories.title: Six months until the next Making Tax Digital phase
stories.summary: An accountancy update dated 6 October says HMRC expects about 1.077 million more sole traders and landlords with qualifying income over £30,000 to keep digital records and send quarterly updates from April 2027; HMRC is urging early preparation. The underlying HMRC press release is dated 5 October.

stories.title: Airports to go contactless in major boost for UK passengers
stories.summary: A phased rollout from 6 October lets eligible travellers use facial checks at eGates without presenting a passport to the reader; the Home Office says tests show up to 25% faster processing. The initial phase is for British citizens at East Midlands Airport, and passengers must still carry their passports.

stories.title: Mental health support for British nationals in Singapore
stories.summary: New FCDO guidance lists local emergency and mental-health support contacts, medicine-access advice and information about hospital care and insurance for British nationals in Singapore.

stories.title: DWP's special advisers' gifts, hospitality and meetings, January to March 2026
stories.summary: DWP published quarterly transparency data covering gifts and hospitality received by special advisers and meetings with senior media figures. The release was first published on 6 October at 09:30 UK time.

stories.title: Ofwat Chair reappointed
stories.summary: Iain Coucher has been reappointed for a second term as Ofwat chair, beginning 1 October 2026 and ending when the new integrated water regulator is established, no later than 30 June 2029.

stories.title: UK special forces could face prosecution as Afghanistan evidence referred to police
stories.summary: The BBC reports that evidence suggesting possible serious offences in UK special-forces detention operations in Afghanistan from 2010 to 2013 was referred to the Defence Serious Crime Unit. Criminal investigations are paused pending the public inquiry.

agencies.name: BIST
agencies.description: Business, Innovation, Science and Trade (grouped business/trade and science/technology coverage)

stories.title: BIST digital service performance indicators
stories.summary: BIST's 6 October transparency publication provides monthly usage, transaction, completion and satisfaction measures for its digital services. The accompanying guidance says to use the data to track individual services over time rather than compare different services without considering their differing measures.

stories.title: Ten NHS trusts referred over monitoring consent
stories.summary: NHS England told the Lampard Inquiry it had referred 10 mental-health trusts to the CQC after finding consent procedures for bedroom camera-based monitoring did not align with its digital principles. The trusts were not named.

stories.title: Diagnostic waiting times and activity for August 2026 — release scheduled
stories.summary: NHS England posted a release notice for August diagnostic waiting-time and activity data covering 15 key tests and procedures. The figures are scheduled for publication on 8 October 2026 at 09:30 UK time and had not yet been released when this digest was prepared.

stories.title: Royal Mail parcel delivery prices increase by up to £1.45
stories.summary: A report dated 6 October says Royal Mail parcel prices changed across Standard, Tracked, Special Delivery and Signed For services, with increases varying by service and weight and reaching £1.45.
